div.div: opencode only: nothing in the campaign pipeline or the k3s cluster calls these tools. Install: brew install go, clone lharries/whatsapp-mcp under ~/ZCodeProject/tools, then go build the bridge. The bridge keeps WhatsApp Web multi-device state in a local SQLite store and prints a QR code to pair. Pairing needs the user's phone (WhatsApp > Linked devices); the re-link window is about 20 days. No message is sent by setup; sends happen only on an explicit ask.
